question: If our planet had only 1000 people, how many people would not have access to the internet? (completely offline)
answer_explanation: The Offline Population: About 2.17 billion people remain completely offline or unconnected. So 260 people in our Planet1000 have no access to the internet.

relationship_fact.text: While Europe/North america has 90% internet availability, only 40% in sub-Saharan africa have access

temporal_fact.text: By 2023, India had more internet users than the number of internet users in the entire world back in 2005. In other words, internet penetration has been dramatic in the last 2 decades.

scale_fact.text: "Ethiopia: 106.7 million people offline. This represents one of the lowest percentages of connectivity globally, with over 75% of the population cut off."
